title: Agent graphs
sub: A supervisor's own output picks the next agent from an allowlist, hop by hop, until it has enough to write.

steps.d:
"What is the maximum vent run for the DR-520, and
does anything supersede the manual's figure?"

steps.h: The supervisor hands off to research (hop 1 of 4)
The research agent reports back; state is checkpointed
steps.d:
dr520-manual#4: "a maximum total vent run of 35 feet
and up to 4 elbows … always check for a newer
service bulletin."

steps.h: The supervisor is not satisfied and hands off again (hop 2 of 4)
A second finding, but no number yet
steps.d:
service-bulletin#1: "this bulletin revises the
maximum vent run … does not affect the DR-210
or either dishwasher model."

steps.h: The supervisor hands off a third time (hop 3 of 4)
The third finding has the revised number
steps.d:
service-bulletin#2: "the maximum vent run … is now
25 feet, with up to 3 elbows … supersedes the
35-foot, 4-elbow figure."

steps.h: The supervisor now hands off to the write agent
The write agent drafts the final answer from all three findings
steps.d:
"The DR-520's vent run is limited to 25 feet with up
to 3 elbows [service-bulletin#2], which supersedes
the manual's 35-foot, 4-elbow figure [dr520-manual#4]."
